method: Post-two-review menu-only correctness check; no third ordinary review or rescore. Normal URL, real DOM bounds and click at three desktop sizes.

rows.text: OPERATOR HANDBOOK×MOVE WITH PURPOSE.The Custodian arms after the third memory. Match the physical I / II / III plates to the coil cells. A small numbered bracket marks one clear component: amber is armored, cyan is exposed. It marks a visible surface, not a safe position. Dark coils are inert cover; move to a clear face for the remaining targets. Destroy its three copper coils: armored shutters take chip damage; after each volley they lift for critical hits. Amber lanes lock before firing: move behind cover. Shift close to a charging coil cancels the volley and opens shutters for 3 seconds.Press 1 for the precision rifle or 2 for the pump breacher. The breacher fires eight physical pellets: strongest within 6 m, fading to zero at 24 m. ADS narrows spread modestly. R inserts one shell every 0.55 seconds; fire interrupts after a shell seats. Switching cancels an unfinished insertion. Fallen supplies add 4 shells; memories add 8, capped at 36 reserve. Memory recovery partially restores health and shield.C toggles a lower physical posture and slower movement. Stand only with clear headroom; Ctrl requests standing. C changes are accepted only while grounded and outside phase/vault. Crouched jumps retain the low body; stand before vaulting. Low cover blocks only suitable angles, so watch high ground and flanks.Press Space near thin waist-high cover to vault when the landing is clear; otherwise jump. Vaulting commits briefly: firing and phase wait until landing. Tall walls still require a route around. Hold Tab while moving for a short ground approach to the selected objective; M selects on the paused map. Watch patrols: the trace knows architecture, not danger.One-use EMERGENCY SUIT SERVICE is behind the west extraction blast plate. It powers after three memories and the defeated Custodian. Hold E for 2 uninterrupted seconds on the floor: +40 health (cap 100) and armor refilled to 60. Applied damage interrupts; flanks remain exposed. Extraction uploads only while grounded inside the marked uplink deck. Outside pauses briefly; reenter before decay.Engineering has two single-use amber capacitor banks. Shoot the cabinet or isolator: a 1.1-second warning precedes a 6 m discharge. Move clear, use solid cover or phase protection. The spent cabinet remains cover. Enemy fire cannot trigger it.W A S D MoveMOUSE LookLMB Fire selected weaponRMB Aim down sightsR Reload1 / 2 Rifle / pump breacherSHIFT Soul Shift / dashC Toggle crouchCTRL Sprint / stand if clearSPACE Vault low cover / jumpHOLD E Recover nearby memoryM Facility map · mission pausedESC Pause / release mousePatrol perimeter shutters lift amber for 0.55 seconds before a radial proximity discharge. Back beyond reach, break solid-cover sight, jump to unreachable height, or Shift to interrupt. A miss still cools for one second; existing projectiles remain dangerous.Soul Shift protects briefly. Dash within 4.5 m of a charging enemy to cancel its shot or proximity discharge and stagger it for 0.8 s. A blue emitter flash confirms the break. Dashing toward a charge stops early on a successful break so you can follow up. Sideways dodges retain full travel. It deals no damage; the 4.5 s cooldown still applies. Your shield regenerates when you avoid damage.THREAT VISOR · Orange ! means a charging threat. Muted chevrons show recent fire or hits. A number counts nearby sources in that direction; one source has no number. Offscreen cues use broad direction sectors, not exact positions. Optic brackets stay beside visible emitters. The lower readout follows one target near aim. Cues require clear optic sight and expire.UNDERSTOOD ↗
